_meta.budget: S1 15 s + S2 5 s + S3 15 s = 35 s (budget 90 s; each shot <= 25 s).
_meta.rules: Skippable from the first frame (Skip button and Esc). Captioned. Reduced motion shows a still frame with the same captions. S1 plays before the first moment of a run, S2 plays before the time-check moment's choices appear, S3 opens the debrief. None plays while a decision is on screen.

captions: Your first session with this group: three Grade 7 students, 30 minutes, linear equations.
Watch the students, not just their answers. How they sit and where they look tells you a lot.
shots.description: The camera follows the tutor's view from the doorway to the near side of a small table. Three students sit across the table: one talking, one with a pencil ready, one leaning back with a hood up. A whiteboard is behind them and a wall clock is to the right.
shots.reducedMotion: Still frame of the table from the tutor's seat, with both captions.

captions: Three minutes left in the session.
shots.description: The view turns to the wall clock, which shows three minutes left.
shots.reducedMotion: Still frame of the wall clock with the caption.

captions: Session over. Let's look at what happened, moment by moment.
The timeline shows each choice and how each student's understanding, engagement and confidence changed.
shots.description: The camera rises above the table to an overview of the three students while the debrief timeline appears.
shots.reducedMotion: Still overview of the table with both captions.
